items.title: Add CI GitHub Actions badge to README
items.description:
Update README.md to include a GitHub Actions status badge for the CI workflow defined in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Requirements:
- Add a visible badge near the top of README.md (title/header area).
- Badge should point to the CI workflow page in this repository.
- Use the standard GitHub Actions badge URL for workflow file ci.yml.
- Keep existing README content intact aside from the badge placement.

Acceptance criteria:
- README.md renders a CI badge in GitHub.
- Badge links to the CI workflow page.
- No unrelated README edits.

items.title: Write Ralph Loop high-level design documentation
items.description:
Create docs/RalphLoop.md with a high-level design document for Ralph Loop.

Scope:
- Describe the purpose of Ralph Loop and the single-agent / 1-WIP execution model.
- Describe the main workflow from backlog selection through branch creation, Codex execution, PR creation, CI/review repair loop, merge, and backlog completion.
- Include all backlog item states and transition rules (New, InProgress, InReview, Done).
- Include failure/recovery behaviors at a high level (CI failures, review changes requested, max repair cycles, resume after interruption).
- Document key files/components (backlog.json, config.json, scripts/ralph.ps1, agent adapter, feedback collector, backlog CLI).

Requirements:
- Documentation should be high-level and operationally useful.
- Use Markdown headings and concise sections.
- Do not rewrite implementation code; explain workflow and state machine.

Acceptance criteria:
- docs/RalphLoop.md exists and is readable.
- Loop states and transitions are explicitly documented.
- Workflow includes repair/retry and merge completion paths.
